note: Thunderwell Core floor v1, approved. Theme id thunderwell. Masters are the @2x PNGs, drawn at half size; plain PNGs are the 1x fallbacks. Pixel sizes below are the masters. room_edge_dark is a darkness-only teal vignette (max 50/255) with no board shape; the hole is generated from the cell footprint. glow_mask is RGB data, lossless, linear, sampled with no source_color hint: R is trace intensity at full range, G is the flow ramp (same rate on every tile), B is 0. The shader uses glow = R * glow_strength * pulse(G). glow_color tints traces green near 140 degrees. pillar_color is pale green-white. pillar_strength 0.45 scales the additive pillar (1.0 washes its cell and the move tiles beside it); the sprite is anchored bottom-centre and sorts with that cell, under the fighter and the move highlight. pad_blue_color near 225 degrees and pad_red_color near 350 degrees are the painted hues; pad_strength only scales them. Floor, pads, pillar and the vignette keep source_color. 2D HDR and bloom are preview-only.
